description: Returns the fields a bank account needs for a payout rail, so a recipient form can collect and validate them before calling create bank account. Each field has a `label`, the request body `key` to send it under, a validation `regex`, and, where the value comes from a fixed list (banks, countries, account types), the allowed `items`. Get valid `rail` values from `GET /v1/available/rails`. Public: no API key required.
name: GetV1AvailableBankDetails
title: Get Available Bank Details
